title: Variety records: legumes (e.g. beans, cowpea, lentil, chickpea) (open sources)
context: legumes (e.g. beans, cowpea, lentil, chickpea) are important crops with openly-documented varieties in gene banks and public catalogs.
objective: Compile documented variety records for legumes (e.g. beans, cowpea, lentil, chickpea) from open sources, following the schema with a citation and license per record.
acceptanceCriteria: >=15 records across >=2 legumes (e.g. beans, cowpea, lentil, chickpea), each with source + license
No proprietary catalogs or agronomic advice
